summary: Iteration 10 fully tested (backend + frontend). Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py: 11/11 PASS — POST /auth/login with {pin,device_id,device_label} returns {success,token,device_id,active_devices,max_devices:2}; 2-device cap verified end-to-end (d1→d2 keeps both; d3 evicts d1 (LRU), GET /auth/sessions returns only [d3,d2], max_devices=2); GET /auth/sessions returns sessions[{device_id,device_label,created_at,last_used}] with max_devices+active and NO token field; DELETE /auth/sessions/{id} = 200 for existing, 404 for nonexistent; GET /api/subscription includes has_access:bool (true for trial/active, false otherwise); auto-expire path verified by direct mongo write of next_cycle_start='2025-01-01' + status='active' → /subscription returns status='expired' + has_access=false AND persists subscription_status='expired' in DB. Frontend Playwright (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844): Login page .brand-logo-wrap has border:'2px solid rgb(232,125,47)' (gold), background:white, boxShadow visible; POST /api/auth/login body contains the localStorage-seeded mgr_device_id ('test_frontend_dev_id'); Manager sidebar has data-testid='nav-subscribe' linking to /subscribe; in active state no explore-mode-banner; in subscription_status='none' state: nav-{orders,tables,menu,sales} all have className containing 'locked' + lock SVG icon, clicking nav-orders redirects to /subscribe, nav-profile + nav-settings remain unlocked + functional, explore-mode-banner text = 'Subscribe to unlock — Start your 4-day free trial...'; in subscription_status='expired' state: visiting /manager force-redirects to /subscribe (per useEffect), banner copy verified in source as 'Subscription expired — Your last cycle ended... Pay now to restore full access' + button 'Pay & Resume'. Subscribe page qr-preview-card text = 'Your 20 QR codes / One QR per table. Print, laminate & place on each table.' — NO 'Each scans to ...' string, NO 'zentaapqr.com' string in card, no .cycle-pill with the domain (only Started/Ends on pills); data-testid='subscribe-print-qr-btn' present and clicking it calls window.open (verified via window.open mock). Payment logos: pay-logo-{upi,card,bank,wallet} all render with non-empty SVGs; pay-logo-upi has exactly 3 polygons (UPI triangle); 0 lucide Smartphone/CreditCard/Building2/Wallet icons in any .payment-card. Settings → devices-card renders with text 'Active Devices · 1/2 ... Chrome on Linux · THIS DEVICE'; .session-row.this-device present; no revoke btn shown on this-device row (as spec). Mobile @ 390x844: data-testid='mobile-nav-toggle' visible (display:flex), clicking it opens sidebar drawer (.layout.mobile-nav-open .sidebar visible), .mobile-nav-backdrop click closes it; Subscribe page payment-grid uses single column at 390px (gridTemplateColumns='342px').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1200 lines (further bloat from prior iter9 1110). Should be split into routers/{auth,subscription,payments,orders,settings}.py — single-file backends are increasingly hard to RCA. Carry-over.

Manager.jsx useEffect that force-redirects on status='expired' redirects on EVERY render where active is not profile/settings — fine, but causes a flash of the loading UI before redirect. Consider gating the initial active state to 'profile' when subscription.status='expired' to avoid the flash.

Subscribe.jsx still ~588 lines and packs the full screen (price calc, QR preview, autopay, payment cards, payment trigger, hidden print frame). The new PaymentLogos.jsx extraction is good — recommend continuing the split: Subscribe/{QrPreview,AutopayCard,PayMethods,PrintLayout}.jsx.

SettingsSection.jsx is ~594 lines (DevicesCard + theme + bill branding + tax + printer + change PIN + customer PIN + recover PIN). Should be split into Settings/{DevicesCard,BillBranding,PinManagement,ThemeCard}.jsx for maintainability.

Backend POST /auth/login does NOT bind the session token to the manager profile (it's stored under scope='manager' globally). If you add multi-manager support later, this scope will need an owner_id. Note for future.

GET /auth/sessions returns timestamps as raw ISO strings — frontend SettingsSection.jsx parses with new Date(). If the backend ever sends a naive datetime, the UI could show 'Invalid Date'. Defensive parsing in the UI would help.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all screens + locked nav + mobile drawer + payment logos verified)

test_credentials: Manager PIN 1234 (unchanged). mgr_device_id is auto-generated in localStorage on login.
seed_data_creation: Test created/deleted session docs in db.sessions with device_id prefix 'test_' (auto-cleaned in fixture teardown). Briefly toggled db.settings {key:'restaurant'}.subscription_status between 'active'→'expired'→'none'→back to 'active'; next_cycle_start was bounced through '2025-01-01' for the auto-expire test, then restored to a future date (+30d, then +20d from now). Final state: subscription_status='active', next_cycle_start ~= now+20d.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter10 features verified. Known confirmed testids: brand-logo-wrap (on Login + Manager sidebar), nav-subscribe, nav-{orders,tables,menu,sales,profile,settings} with .locked class when has_access=false, explore-mode-banner with conditional copy ('Subscribe to unlock' vs 'Subscription expired'), explore-subscribe-btn ('Start Free Trial' vs 'Pay & Resume'), qr-preview-card (no 'Each scans to' text, no zentaapqr.com pill), subscribe-print-qr-btn (calls window.open), pay-logo-{upi,card,bank,wallet} (inline SVGs replacing lucide icons), devices-card with 'Active Devices · N/2', .session-row.this-device + revoke-session-{id} on others, mobile-nav-toggle, .mobile-nav-backdrop, .layout.mobile-nav-open. Backend POST /auth/login NEEDs device_id+device_label in body for tracking (defaults to random hex if absent). 3rd-device login auto-evicts LRU session, max_devices=2. GET /api/subscription auto-expires on past next_cycle_start when last_payment_at is before (next_cycle-1d). Subscription state is now 'active' with next_cycle ~+20d.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Implementation matches the spec end-to-end. Minor UX nit: status='expired' causes a redirect-flash on /manager since initial active='orders'; not a bug but could be smoother by starting on 'profile' when expired (mentioned in critical_code_review_comments).
